newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan seeks 50,000 T yellow corn for Nov shipment.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks 50,000 T yellow corn for Nov shipment.

text.p: Jordan is seeking to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. No 3 yellow corn in one lot for shipment in the first half of November, traders said on Thursday.
They said offers of corn of better grade, or equivalent origin, would also be acceptable.
They said offers must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by September 25. Jordan has an annual consumption of yellow corn of around 400,000 to 500,000 tonnes.
